name: autonomy-run
summary: Operator command /autonomy: create, plan, start and manage autonomous runs (the packages/autonomy engine) from inside pi. A run starts only after you confirm its resolved boundary on screen, or from a contract that already carries an authorisation for exactly that boundary; it is a command, not a tool, so the model cannot start, steer, authorise or promote a run.

services: a container engine (Podman or Docker) for the runs themselves
